name: The Wood Remembers
summary: The forest does not forget its children: each dawn it offers you one.

face.name: The Wood Remembers

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Permanent. At the start of each of your turns look at the top card of your deck: if it is an Auros Entity, you may take it into your hand.

face.flavor: Every tree is a name. Every name returns, sooner or later.
